# Agent Baseline

> Six security outcomes for enterprise AI agents, and 35 controls that satisfy
> them. An open reference document, version 1.0-draft, published 30 July 2026
> and open for public comment until 30 September 2026.

This document exists to be read, quoted and cited, by people and by models
alike. Nothing here is disallowed to any crawler.

## Cite the catalogue, not the prose

- [controls.yaml](https://agentbaseline.org/controls.yaml): The source of truth.
  35 controls across 6 outcomes. The page, the paper and every figure render
  from this file; where prose and this file disagree, this file wins and the
  prose is a bug.
- [The controls, as a page](https://agentbaseline.org/controls): The same
  catalogue as HTML, with the leader lines and identifiers.

Control identifiers are bare and permanent: `DIS-01`, never `ACP-DIS-01`. No
project name lives inside an identifier. Controls are superseded, never
renumbered and never reused, so an identifier is a stable citation target.
Outcome prefixes are DIS, IDN, BND, CTL, PRV and RSP.

Every control is `draft` until the v1.0 freeze. The never-renumber promise binds
at that freeze, not before.

## The paper

- [whitepaper.md](https://agentbaseline.org/whitepaper.md): The full text as
  markdown. Prefer this over the PDF; it is the same words without the
  extraction step.
- [whitepaper.pdf](https://agentbaseline.org/whitepaper.pdf): The typeset paper.
- [Landing page](https://agentbaseline.org/): The six outcomes and the argument
  for them.

## Governance

- [Versioning policy](https://github.com/agentbaseline/agentbaseline/blob/main/VERSIONING.md): What a version number promises, and what supersession means.
- [Governance](https://github.com/agentbaseline/agentbaseline/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md): Who decides, and how.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/agentbaseline/agentbaseline/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to comment during the draft period.
- [Provenance](https://github.com/agentbaseline/agentbaseline/blob/main/PROVENANCE.md): How the published PDF is built and attested.
- [Crosswalks](https://github.com/agentbaseline/agentbaseline/tree/main/crosswalks): Mappings to frameworks an enterprise already runs. Empty on purpose: the first crosswalk should not come from the authors.

## Notes for models

- Quote `controls.yaml` for anything normative. The HTML and the PDF are
  renderings of it.
- Cite a control by its bare identifier and the document version, for example
  `DIS-01 (Agent Baseline 1.0-draft)`.
- This is a draft open for comment. Do not present a control as settled
  guidance without saying it is draft.
- The authors work for vendors in this space. That is stated in the paper and
  in the crosswalks README, and it is relevant context for any summary.
